title: World Launches World ID and Zoom Security Tools for Banks

tickers.name: Zoom Communications, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A beta period that began in April has concluded for a new system designed to detect fraudulent synthetic media during video calls. World is packaging this Zoom deepfake check, the World ID identity app and its AI-agent tools into a single bundle for the financial services sector to combat bots and fraud.

The offering shifts the Zoom verification tool to general availability to help banks secure digital transactions and verify users. By consolidating these identity and AI tools, World provides financial firms with a mechanism to prevent impersonation and ensure that participants in a process are unique human users.
